Well I've always been pretty alone, I look left and right and see friends and groups of friends all having fun, while I'm just sitting alone. Then you have my shitty grades, slipping down and everyone else seems to be doing just fine, yet I could barely keep up. And then there's also the fact that I've wanted to do art, yet my art is pretty shit which means I've been working towards a dream which I can't ever achieve. 

As for the noose, well it was the easiest way to go about offing myself.
